maddeler.e:
أتهالك (form VI)
# أَتَهَالَكُ (ʔatahālaku) /ʔa.ta.haː.la.ku/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَهَالَكَ (tahālaka)
# أَتَهَالَكَ (ʔatahālaka) /ʔa.ta.haː.la.ka/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَهَالَكَ (tahālaka)
# أَتَهَالَكْ (ʔatahālak) /ʔa.ta.haː.lak/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَهَالَكَ (tahālaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
